prompts.front: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FRONT orthographic modelling reference, one custom modular cliff mass for Yunlu xianxia floating-island game. Draw ONE isolated solid rock body on clean near-white neutral background, the entire object fully in frame, centered with 12 percent margin. Strict orthographic FRONT elevation, camera horizontal at the object's mid-height, looking straight at its broad outward cliff face, no perspective, no three-quarter view, no top-down composition, no labels/text/border. Asset real dimensions approx width4m height3.2m depth2.2m. Shape: a naturally fractured single geological mass with two unequal main face planes and one small subordinate shoulder, all genuinely grown from ONE calm continuous inward-returning lower body. The left upper shoulder is broad and slightly higher; the right is lower and narrower. Upper skyline is broken into a few irregular stone shoulders, with a shallow saddle, never a level extruded slab. A deep narrow offset vertical cleft separates the upper broad left face from the right, but it ends naturally before reaching the common bottom. Some corners are crisp chipped mineral edges, some are softly weathered. Main faces have strong unequal planes with one or two oblique geological changes of plane; no huge neat triangular tessellation. Lower third gently tapers inward and merges into ONE shallow rounded-angular solid base; no individual hanging teeth, no upward notch, no multiple separate rubble pieces, no sharp ship keel, no ring or waist band. This must read as cohesive natural mountain rock, not a sculpted pillow, concrete wall, stacked blocks, stone monster or packed boulders. Finely chipped matte mineral surface, medium shallow fractures, restrained clean mineral variation, gently warm light grey with cooler recesses, no dirt blanket, no plastic sheen or crumpled foil texture, no cartoon outline. Ancient Chinese painterly 3D game asset finish, refined harmonious natural feel, readable from afar and close. Soft neutral diffuse studio illumination that reveals actual planes without baked dramatic cast shadows. Rock ONLY: no grass, no moss, no vines, no trees, no soil, no land cap, no island, no water, no building or scene; vegetation and terrain are separately editable game modules. The back and sides of this single body must be physically plausible for later consistent left/right/back views. Do not make a concept landscape or a collage.
